loop.top3_why: The median combination is the most robust to model ranking instability and correlated errors, which aligns with the diagnosis that ranking does not hold across windows and several models carry correlated error. loop.top3_why_not: B (dba) has the best overall score but its per‑window performance drops in the last window (0.652) and it is more sensitive to the high‑variance weight estimation in a short validation period. C (mean) performs well in the first window but its last‑window score (0.683) is higher than median’s, indicating less robustness to outlying model predictions. Both are acceptable, but median offers the most stable, risk‑averse approach for this series.
